name: std::toupper
intro:
Converts the given character to uppercase according to the character conversion rules defined by the currently installed C locale.

In the default "C" locale, the following lowercase letters abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz are replaced with respective uppercase letters ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ch

 -

 character to be converted. If the value of ch is not representable as unsigned char and does not equal EOF, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Converted character or ch if no uppercase version is defined by the current C locale.

sections.title: Notes

examples.output:
aA bB cC dD eE fF gG hH iI jJ kK lL mM
nN oO pP qQ rR sS tT uU vV wW xX yY zZ
 
in iso8859-1, toupper('0xb8') gives 0xb8
in iso8859-15, toupper('0xb8') gives 0xb4

summary: Converts the given character to uppercase according to the character conversion rules defined by the currently installed C locale.
